description.en-US: The channel this point belongs to. Immutable (CR 72): a point created under the wrong channel is archived and recreated, never moved, because orders already reference the pair and moving it would rewrite what channel those sales happened in.

A human-facing local code such as 'VM000123'. Optional, mutable, and unique within its channel when present (D-21). Deliberately not an integration identity: nothing resolves a sales point by this, so unlike a channel code it can be corrected after the fact (CR 13). Declared as partial_uniques_strict, which emits only the IS NOT NULL index; the loose variant would also cap a channel at one un-coded point.

The creating module's own id for the thing this point represents — for a kiosk, its Kiosk id (CR 12). Unique within a channel when present, and that pair IS the idempotency mechanism: a vending module retrying CreateSalesPoint after a timeout resolves to the existing point instead of creating a second one (CR 48). Immutable, because changing it would break that resolution. Declared as partial_uniques_strict so that the many points carrying no external reference stay unconstrained. A plain ulid with no edge: the record it names belongs to another module, and a foreign key across that boundary would make Sales depend on its table.

Which kind of record external_reference_id names, as a human-readable '{module}.{resource}' pair — 'vending_machine.kiosk' for a kiosk. Without it the id is ambiguous: two modules may both register points against the same channel, and a bare ulid says nothing about which resource to look it up in. Immutable alongside the id it qualifies, since changing either would repoint the reference.

The business lifecycle. Suspended stops new orders while leaving returns, refunds and history working (CR 14), which is what a temporarily offline kiosk needs. Distinct from is_archived. Written only by the suspend and activate actions.
